header: Stages joined by arrows, from input to output
lead: Use it when the boxes are system states, not tasks for the reader. For steps the reader performs, use the How It Works element.
note: The note holds a legend or a caveat that doesn't fit in the diagram.

stages.title: A column on phones
stages.text: On a phone the stages and arrows run from top to bottom.

stages.title: Row above 768px
stages.text: The arrows turn sideways and sit in the gap between two stages.

stages.title: Two to six stages
stages.text: With more than six, the stages get too narrow to read.

stages.title: A closing note
stages.text: For a caveat that doesn't fit in the boxes.
